In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Fulton County will make available to disabled members of the public disability-related modification or accommodations.

Learn more about the Fulton County Area Plan Commission (F.C.P.C.) Department.

Circuit Court
Explore more information regarding the Fulton County Circuit Court.
Drug Free Fulton County
The mission of Drug Free Fulton County is to bring together community stakeholders to combat alcohol, tobacco and other drug (ATOD) abuse in Fulton County.
Fulton County 911 Communications
It is our mission to promote Teamwork in the center, respect those who have given us their trust, to be accountable to those we serve, maintain Integrity in the performance of our duties and dedicate ourselves to the profession we have chosen.
Emergency Management Agency (EMA)
The Fulton County Emergency Management Agency is established to mitigate, prepare for, respond to and recover from all emergencies and disasters impacting the public, government and business within Fulton County.
Fulton County Soil & Water Conservation District
Learn more about the members and functions of the Fulton County Soil and Water Conservation District.
Highway Department
The Fulton County Highway Department is responsible for all roads, bridges and small structures (less than 20-foot span) within Fulton County that are neither State nor Highways within the corporate limits of a town.
Parks & Recreation
Explore Fulton County parks and volunteer opportunities.
Probation and Community Corrections
Access Probation Office services and contact information.
Public Health
The Public Health Department in Fulton County provides a wide variety of services that keeps our community healthy and safe.
Solid Waste
Welcome to your online source for everything you want to know about recycling in Fulton County, Indiana.
Superior Court
Welcome to the Fulton County Superior Court. For more information on our services provided, please contact our office.
Veterans Affairs
The Fulton County Veterans Service Office is responsible for providing veterans transportation to and from a VA Medical Facility, assisting veterans, their spouses, dependents and survivors with information and assistance concerning veterans' benefits through Federal and State levels.
Voting & Elections
